description: Transcribe one audio file (mp3/wav/m4a/ogg/webm, max 1 MB, via public https audio_url or audio_base64) with OpenAI Whisper large-v3-turbo (MIT) on our Cloudflare Worker via Workers AI, with voice-activity filtering. Returns text, language, duration and optional segments + WebVTT. Audio is not stored. Limited daily capacity: 503 (not charged) when used up. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: POST /api/ai/transcribe.

audio_url.description: public https URL of the audio (max 1 MB)

name: ai_transcribe
title: Speech to text / audio transcription (Whisper large-v3-turbo, timestamps + WebVTT)
